categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches the /rest/getutxos HTTP handler and carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label.
categories.rationale: POST requests to `/rest/getutxos` incorrectly report no UTXO hits for valid outpoints due to misaligned body deserialization offsets. The PR description notes that while GET finds the unspent output, POST prepends a CompactSize length prefix that the parser misreads as the `checkmempool` flag, corrupting parsing; it also bounds vector memory allocation to the 15-outpoint limit.
